metadata.ablation: freeze first live plan; no further model calls

plan.reason: At 10D with only 24/100 evals used and no recent improvement, the surrogate is still data-starved, so auto selection lets held-out RMSE choose between RBF and quadratic instead of committing prematurely. Stagnation and zero recent improvement favor more exploration and a modestly larger radius to escape a local basin, while keeping a local fraction so the current_to_best operator still refines promising regions once the surrogate sharpens. Population/generations are kept moderate to avoid over-consuming the remaining budget per surrogate update.
